notes.title: 3rd Anniversary of Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea!
notes.content:
Today marks the 3rd anniversary of Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea! 3 years ago today it released after a short few months of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/ab7c0384987f1516554c9f6cce53309b23b958eb.png[/img]

The original concept was simple—an unlikely duo travel the Victorian countryside and towns searching for a cure to vampirism. The story expanded into the 26k adventure it is today, focused on the four main characters Nemo, Cecil, Lucie, and Ambrose. Since release, over 4k people have traveled with them across Steam & itchio!

Earlier this year we announced [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]a sequel game, Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url], set around 5 years after the events of the first game, following Lucie as the protagonist in an otome-style mystery with 3 love interests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/b2cecee48fd08d71eec21d9c4e3d90ce8f5275b3.jpg[/img]

We've been working on this sequel for months and recently released an updated demo in October. If you're eager to see the main 4 back again as well as a new cast of characters, then give it a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/
[previewyoutube=xCTSYrJJX-g;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the 3rd anniversary, we have some new chibi artwork of Lucie with each of her love interests, illustrated by alte_27!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/d2baed067ebbb1351d91dd184ab66f33d797c80b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/2bb614d71b7a43b8af503fd41bac8cf15d0a3a83.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/26f6fb134b624dd43d00300d414013ffc17db8f9.jpg[/img]

Thank you for all of the support for both games!

p.s. all of [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalgameworks/link/WINTER2024]our merch is 10% off[/url] until new years day~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/a3160639f887ef65638c9459607b1649ca494970.jpg[/img]

— Arimia

notes.title: GUI Overhaul + Other Updates
notes.content:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea recently celebrated its 1st anniversary! It's been played over 2,000 times across Steam and itch.io- thank you to everyone who's played it so far!

Today's update of the game is mostly graphical. The GUI was always a placeholder one and now the full GUI has been implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/c9dc9fb5cc993c1d345aac00ccc69a441aa66020.png[/img]

This GUI overhaul includes a Gallery, a new menu that allows you to see the cut scene artwork from the game. This menu can be accessed once you finish the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/85bfa55a7f9d170ff665ada0dbdb85aaa1ee37ac.png[/img]

Along with the updated GUI, I also fixed a few typos in the script. This will most likely be the last update for the game, so I hope you enjoy!

If you'd like to read more about the development process, there's [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea/]several devlogs on our website you can read[/url].

One last things- you can now buy keychains of the cast of Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea for [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalgameworks/shop]our merch store[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/14b36bf6e932c6fdc6d07b792e521cf537d95080.jpg[/img]

You can [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalgameworks/shop]get them here[/url] ♥

— Arimia

notes.title: Achievements are live!
notes.content:
Achievements are now live and working in this latest update! Thank you everyone who's played Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea so far, the reception has been wonderful and I'm truly happy people are liking this type of visual novel.

If you'd like to read more about the development process, [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea/]check out our devlogs[/url]!

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h1][i]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea[/i] is now released![/h1]
🎉🎉🎉

After 4 months of solo development, CWES is now out to the world. What started as a few scribblings in my sketchbook in August is now a fully playable story about a group of 4 people navigating the Victorian era and the aftermath of an unsolved vampire attack from a decade prior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41477389/b33952d5cc3f5459acabb77aeb0c9899d758ec14.jpg[/img]

Treat this more as a tale that you're coming along for the ride for rather than an interactive story, as this is a kinetic novel with no choices. Sit back for 2 hours and follow Cecil and Nemo along their travels.

I hope you'll enjoy the journey.

— Arimia
